blocks.text: The Philippines is moving forward to the next round of the 2026 Miss Grand International pageant’s “Country’s Power of the Year” online voting, one of the ways fans can help delegates move closer to the crown. For the first round of voting, the public had 48 hours to vote for the country of their choice on the Miss Grand International pageant’s official Instagram page. Voting closed on Sept. 27 at 11 P.M.
